name: striped-pattern
title: Striped Pattern
description: A background striped pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the SVG. Stripes use the text colour; set the thickness with `stroke-[…]`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of one pattern tile in pixels (the spacing of the stripes).

props.name: height
props.description: Height of one pattern tile in pixels.
